# TalentHub Consultant — Recruitment & Executive Search
> Find the perfect fit for your company. Helping ambitious professionals discover meaningful careers while empowering organizations to build high-performing teams across Pune and Western India.

TalentHub Consultant is a premier recruitment consultancy and corporate staffing agency headquartered in Katraj, Pune (411046). We specialize in IT & software engineering, automotive & manufacturing, BFSI & FinTech, healthcare, and executive leadership recruitment across the Pune industrial and technology corridors (Hinjawadi, Kharadi, Chakan, Magarpatta, Baner, Bhosari, and Talegaon).

## Core Practice Areas
- **Contingent Technical Staffing**: Zero upfront fee; pre-vetted engineers and functional specialists with 90-day replacement guarantee.
- **Retained Executive Search**: Confidential leadership recruitment for CXOs, VPs, and Engineering Directors.
- **Industrial & Plant Recruitment**: Specialized mechanical, CNC, quality assurance, and plant operations for Chakan & Bhosari manufacturing belts.
- **RPO & Volume Hiring Drives**: Dedicated on-demand recruitment teams for scaling startups and enterprise expansions.
